propositions: Every CI test phase ≥1.0s across three selected Gerrit Verify runs and one exhaustive local macOS census has been audited; no individual pytest setup/call/teardown phase exceeded 30s.

Gerrit 1817 (commit 53efe2426e) already removed 19 proven OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS/Ubuntu 3.11/3.12, saving ~8s macOS wall and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds with no new job/runner overhead; organic descendants remain N=0 for post-merge delta measurement.

501 unique ≥1.0s phases have been inventoried and classified into nine disposition families: git-store-concurrency (real APFS/BSD locking/crash-recovery), gate-identity-signing (material pinning/attestation), analyzer-grounding (real binary discovery/tool/timeout), import-packaging (crash-safe commits and resume), deploy-reviewbot (process/shell/restart behavior), pandoc (bounded live binary probes), editor-e2e (real external contracts), other-contract (various public seams), and api-reconciler-schema; all kept as real boundaries or marked for equivalence-only consolidation.

No faster oracle, mock replacement, or equivalent static corpus has been proven sufficient to replace the 22.63s write-burst, 21.96s import-benchmark, or key concurrency/partial-clone/process phases without loss of filesystem/Git/socket/timeout/tool-discovery/platform fidelity; removal remains blocked by lack of equivalence proof.

macOS-to-Ubuntu routing is rejected for all remaining candidate families because they contain real platform behavior (filesystem locks, Git subprocess, partial-clone protocol, process management) that cannot be proven invariant across OS without shard/job overhead already measured as counterproductive (coercive-paediatric-bug: job minutes 18.6→21.0, burst contention 22.3→25.2).

Ranked next actions prioritize approved test-only window/clock injection (songful-groovelike-horsemouse) for deployment/observability scripts; defer research on fault-seeded equivalence (lead-unpleasing-kitten, reasonable-kingsize-polliwog, rival-ammoniacal-crustacean); retain platform suites, real scanner boundaries, and concurrency seams; monitor but do not artificially trigger re-measurement of Gerrit 1817's organic delta; reject new macOS/Ubuntu shard creation.
